record.reason: Misrouter optimizes adversarial prompts to steer a MoE service toward weakly aligned experts and tests safety bypass/output quality on surrogate and public services. The objective and evaluation concern security attacks, not inference cost, memory, latency, throughput, or serving mechanisms. Authors identify limited route controllability, coupled objectives, and output-quality degradation as limitations. The shared MoE architecture alone does not create an in-scope serving-efficiency contribution.
record.title: Misrouter: Exploiting Routing Mechanisms for Input-Only Attacks on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
